finding: The rewritten comment narrows the losing window to 'the give-back's retries', but the give-back also loses to a folder made before its first attempt
why: _patient retries only on PermissionError, so with no file-in-use error there are no retries; a lock folder made by a polling writer between the stealing rename (line 209) and the give-back rename (line 214) still wins, which is exactly the case the new tests' before_give_back hook models.
fix: Say 'between the steal and a successful give-back' instead of 'during the give-back's retries'.
evidence: manifest.py:288 '# unless another writer makes (Windows) or claims (POSIX) the lock during the give-back's retries.' vs test_team_manifest.py:37/45/54 steal_with(..., before_give_back=newcomer(lock)) with in_use=0, i.e. no retry ever happens and the gap still loses on Windows (line 48 asserts no owner). (also reported by test-veracity: Comment narrows the lost-give-back window to the retries; the new tests show it opens before the first attempt)
